entities.name: Rajhrad Benedictine Monastery
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Rajhrad Abbey is a Benedictine abbey in Rajhrad in the South Moravian Region, Czech Republic. It was founded by Duke Bretislav I in 1045. It was the first Benedictine male monastery in the country and first historically mentioned monastery in Moravia.
